messages:
Dana: quick heads-up — new bootcamp cohort hit a nasty edge with jsonMode + streaming function calls. the JS joiner attempts to unescape per-chunk, and when a backslash escape is split across chunks we end up corrupting the assembled payload and JSON.parse fails. repro and logs below.

Dana: repro (node):
```js
const c = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true, streaming: true });
await c.chat.complete({ model: 'rw-mini', messages: [{role:'user', content:'echo \"quote\"'}], functions: [{ name: 'echo', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { t: { type: 'string' } }, required:['t'] } }] });
```

Dana: observed stream chunks (example):
```
chunk1: '{"name":"echo","arguments":{"t":"He said: \"}}'
chunk2: '"hello"}}'
assembled: '{"name":"echo","arguments":{"t":"He said: \\\"\"hello"}}'
JSON.parse error: Unexpected token h in JSON at position  forty-something
```

Omar: ugh. so the joiner is running a per-chunk unescape that turns `\\` + `"` across boundary into a single escaped quote incorrectly. py-sdk avoids this by buffering full slices. which sdk/samplekit?

Dana: js-sdk@0.9.7, samplekit v0.19-bootcamp, reproduced locally and in cloud quickstart. py-sdk not affected per partner report.

Kai: likely fix: don’t unescape until full message assembled. change joiner to be escape-aware: if a chunk ends with a backslash or a partial unicode escape sequence, hold it and concatenate next chunk before any decode. add unit covering trailing-backslash and split-unicode cases.

Omar: agreed. also add an integration parity test comparing assembled bytes js <> py for function call payloads with quotes and escapes. small mitigation: trim and retry parse with a permissive mode for bootcamp containers but we should fix serializer.

Dana: opened draft PR with small buffering change and tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/321 (WIP). includes a note in the quickstart troubleshooting doc.

ci-bot: samplekit-ci build #624 queued (logs: https://ci.internal/samplekit/624)

Kai: thanks Dana. I'll review PR and add the parity e2e. marking this P2 but will escalate if instructors continue to block. :thumbsup:
